title.zh: 将保和省布埃纳维斯塔市镇克鲁斯描笼涯克鲁斯小学的名称变更为Policarpo Tirol小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Cruz Elementary School in Barangay Cruz, Municipality of Buenavista, Province of Bohol, to Policarpo Tirol Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Cruz Elementary School in Barangay Cruz, Municipality of Buenavista, Province of Bohol, to Policarpo Tirol Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Cruz tại Barangay Cruz, Thị trấn Buenavista, Tỉnh Bohol thành Trường tiểu học Policarpo Tirol
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Cruz ในบารังไกย์ Cruz, เทศบาล Buenavista, จังหวัด Bohol เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Policarpo Tirol
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Cruz di Barangay Cruz, Kotamadya Buenavista, Provinsi Bohol menjadi Sekolah Dasar Policarpo Tirol
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Cruz di Barangay Cruz, Perbandaran Buenavista, Wilayah Bohol menjadi Sekolah Rendah Policarpo Tirol

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6707_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Cruz Elementary School in Barangay Cruz, Municipality of Buenavista, Province of Bohol, shall hereafter be known as the Policarpo Tirol Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
